plugin.multiview.add_ahist_title: Adds an AUDIO history strip placed directly on the wall (peak envelope, clipping, silence) — assign an audio source in the panel below or from the Cables page.
plugin.multiview.add_clock_title: Add a clock / timecode (PTP, stopwatch or countdown)
plugin.multiview.add_image_title: Add an image (logo or background) imported from your computer
plugin.multiview.add_meterblock_title: Adds a VU meters block placed directly on the wall (independent of any window) — assign it an audio source in the panel below or via the Cables page.
plugin.multiview.add_pip_title: Shows the first hidden entry of the bank again (its wired source is kept); assign it a source in the panel below or via the Cables page.
plugin.multiview.add_text_title: Add a text field (local text or TSL)
plugin.multiview.add_vhist_title: Adds a VIDEO history strip placed directly on the wall (one thumbnail per second + freeze/black/signal-loss ribbon) — assign a video source in the panel below or from the Cables page.
plugin.multiview.audio_source_title: Source feeding the VU meters (`meters` components of the PiP template, including the Classic fallback). Defaults to automatically following the audio stream paired with the video source above; can be forced to a different audio stream, or explicitly turned off (audio-only cell without video → no meter).
plugin.multiview.block_hidden_title: Hides the element without deleting it: its settings and cabling are kept (handy to compare the wall's cost with and without).
plugin.multiview.cd_warn_title: Countdown: switches to the alert colour as it approaches 0
plugin.multiview.col_visible_title: A hidden entry keeps its wired source
plugin.multiview.copy_settings_title: Copy the window settings (position and source excluded)
plugin.multiview.delete_hb_title: Removes this strip from the wall (source unwired).
plugin.multiview.delete_mb_title: Deletes this VU meters block from the wall (audio source unwired).
plugin.multiview.edit_layout_title: Load this layout into the editor to modify it (without redeploying the wall)
plugin.multiview.export_title: Download this layout as .json (re-importable on another orchestrator)
plugin.multiview.fabric_regions_hint: Dashed lines: compute regions. Moving a window within its region is immediate; moving it across a boundary rebuilds a region (a few seconds).
plugin.multiview.fabric_reorganizing: ⟳ Rebuilding the wall — the output will switch in a few seconds…
plugin.multiview.fill_h_title: Tile selected windows to fill the full width
plugin.multiview.fill_v_title: Tile selected windows to fill the full height
plugin.multiview.flash_bank_full: Bank full: all {n} entries are already on screen (increase "Max inputs").
plugin.multiview.flash_copied: Settings copied (position excluded). Select the target windows then Paste.
plugin.multiview.flash_deploy_failed: Deployment failed: the displayed composition has not been applied.
plugin.multiview.flash_editing_layout: Editing layout "{name}": adjust the editor then "Save changes".
plugin.multiview.flash_invalid_layout_fi: Invalid file: multiview layout expected ({name, config}).
plugin.multiview.flash_load_failed: Could not load the multiview. Reselect the instance or check the container.
plugin.multiview.flash_nothing_to_paste: Nothing to paste: copy a window's settings first.
plugin.multiview.flash_pip_template_relo: Template reloaded and re-pushed to the wall.
plugin.multiview.flash_select2: Select at least 2 windows (the last one is the reference).
plugin.multiview.flash_select3: Select at least 3 windows to distribute.
plugin.multiview.flash_select_mv_first: Select a multiview to edit first.
plugin.multiview.flash_select_targets: Select one or more target windows.
plugin.multiview.flash_template_short: Template {name}: only {n} window(s) in the bank — increase "Max inputs" to complete it.
plugin.multiview.format_changed_redeploy: Output format changed — redeploy to apply.
plugin.multiview.fps_target_title: Target rate for this wall. If the multiview saturates, the composition fabric splits it automatically to hold this rate (auto = global cluster budget).
plugin.multiview.freeze_detect_title: FREEZE badge when the source picture has not advanced for N seconds
plugin.multiview.genlock_title: Locks the output phase to the PTP grid. Structural param: a change redeploys the container.
plugin.multiview.hb_duration_title: Depth of the displayed history (10, 30, 60 or 120 s).
plugin.multiview.hb_events_title: Ribbon under the strip: freeze (amber), black (indigo), signal loss (red). The thumbnail captured AT THE MOMENT of the event is pinned into its cell.
plugin.multiview.hb_source_title: Source of this strip — independent from any window. Can also be wired from the Cables page (port “Video hist. N” / “Audio hist. N”).
plugin.multiview.hint: Shift + click for multi-select. Reference = last selected (white frame).
plugin.multiview.label_proportional_titl: Text size follows the window size: = defined size when the window is 1/4 of the picture, then grows/shrinks accordingly.
plugin.multiview.layouts_empty: No saved layout. Compose a multiview then "Save current editor".
plugin.multiview.lock_conflict: This wall changed since you opened it. Your last action was NOT applied — reload to start from the real state.
plugin.multiview.lock_conflict_by: {nom} changed this wall since you opened it. Your last action was NOT applied — reload to start from the real state.
plugin.multiview.lock_held_by: This wall is being edited by {nom} ({min} min) — your changes would not be saved.
plugin.multiview.lock_readonly_flash: Wall edited by {nom}: take over to make changes.
plugin.multiview.mb_audio_source_title: Audio source of this block — independent of any window. Can also be wired from the Cables page (« VU wall N » port).
plugin.multiview.mb_ch_start_title: Starting channel (1-based) in the 16-channel space (2 flows of 8) of the wired source.
plugin.multiview.mb_label_title: Optional name shown on this block's port, Cables page.
plugin.multiview.mb_width_mode_title: Fixed = the meter's intrinsic width (alignment applies). Follows block width = the bars fill the whole block (ticks/spacing stay fixed).
plugin.multiview.no_selection_msg: Pick a multiview on the left to edit its composition.
plugin.multiview.orientation_title: Portrait wall: composed vertically (1080×1920), then the engine rotates the image 90° into the landscape frame (panel physically tilted). The emitted stream stays 1920×1080. Structural parameter: a change redeploys the container.
plugin.multiview.out_format_title: Output resolution/rate. Comes from the system setting (Video formats); structural parameter: a change redeploys the container.
plugin.multiview.paste_settings_title: Paste the settings into the selected windows
plugin.multiview.pip_default_template_ti: PiP template applied by default to ALL windows of this wall (inheritance). Each window can override it (another template, or "classic dressing") in its panel.
plugin.multiview.pip_template_reload_tit: Re-reads the template from the library (Settings → PiP) and re-pushes it live to the wall — useful after editing the template while this wall stays open.
plugin.multiview.pip_template_title: Replaces the window dressing (name/tally/meters/ANC) with a template composed in Settings → PiP. "classic dressing" = the historical settings below.
plugin.multiview.remove_pip_title: Removes the PiP from the picture WITHOUT cutting its source: the entry stays wired and can be shown again.
plugin.multiview.row_toggle_title: Show / remove this PiP from the picture — the source stays wired
plugin.multiview.show_format_title: Discreet chip at the bottom right of each window: declared source format (e.g. 1920×1080p25)
plugin.multiview.show_no_signal_title: Shows a NO SIGNAL panel in the window when its source is missing
plugin.multiview.show_proxy_title: Engineering mode: badge at the top left of each window showing the pyramid proxy read and its cost (¼ ~ octave, 952×536 ✓ pure copy, full ↯ gather)
plugin.multiview.template_title: Applies a predefined grid to the bank windows (sources are kept)
plugin.multiview.tools_windows_only: Multiple selection is for video windows only: a text, clock, image, meter block or history strip is selected on its own. Align and Fill work on it; match size, distribute and copy settings need several windows.
plugin.multiview.tsl_central_help: Tally/UMD provided by the orchestrator's TSL service (Settings → Protocols → TSL).
plugin.multiview.tsl_direct_help: The controller (VSM…) must point at this multiview's IP, on this port.
type.multiview.cfg.cadence.help: genlock: waits for the PTP grid (default). input: emits as soon as an input has a new frame (intermediate stage of a fabric, whole-frame). flow: sliced fabric — targets the epoch index, requires slice mode to be eligible.
type.multiview.cfg.cadence.label: Composition pacing
type.multiview.cfg.freeze_detect_s.label: Frozen-frame detection (s, 0 = off)
type.multiview.cfg.gpu_batch_bands.help: Number of MXL bands per GPU batch. ⚠ The cost per BATCH is fixed (kernel launches, transfers): too many batches and the frame blows up. Gate bench of 2026-08-07 on a T4 — whole frame 3.0 ms of compose, mega-bands of 540 lines 5.1 ms, bands of 36 lines 45.6 ms. Verdict GO-MEGA-540: at 1080p/36 lines, k=15 gives 2 batches of 540 lines. Measured in production on 2026-08-09: k=8 (288 lines) already gives own=24.5 ms and 11 dropped frames/s — 540 is a THRESHOLD, not an order of magnitude. 1 = band by band (rejected by the bench).
type.multiview.cfg.gpu_batch_bands.label: Bands per GPU batch (micro-batch)
type.multiview.cfg.gpu_slice.help: Allows slice mode on a GPU wall (band-by-band composition in VRAM). MEASURED IN PRODUCTION on 2026-08-11 on a Quadro P5000: 1920x1080p50 held at 50.0 fps, zero dropped frame, own cost 13 ms out of a 20 ms budget. Leaves ~6 ms of margin instead of 11: watch the frame rate after enabling it on a wall heavily loaded with branding.
type.multiview.cfg.gpu_slice.label: GPU slice (bench opt-in)
type.multiview.cfg.interlace_mode.help: The wall always outputs progressive: a 1080i source must be de-interlaced. “Weave” recombines both fields and gives full vertical resolution — this is the setting that makes burnt-in graphics from the source legible. “Single field” is the historical behaviour: half the vertical resolution, but immune to motion. Weaving combs on fast motion; downscaling to the thumbnail absorbs most of it.
type.multiview.cfg.interlace_mode.label: Interlaced sources
type.multiview.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.multiview.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.multiview.cfg.max_inputs.label: Max inputs
type.multiview.cfg.mvk.help: Speeds composition up by 4.8 to 6.2×. To be DISABLED if the wall dies with “code -11” (SIGSEGV): the numpy fallback is the old path, bit-exact — you lose speed, never correctness. Takes effect when the script is redeployed.
type.multiview.cfg.mvk.label: Fused composition kernel (C)
type.multiview.cfg.orientation.label: Orientation
type.multiview.cfg.scale_filter.help: A thumbnail is a reduction of its source (1920×1080 in a 640×360 cell = 1 pixel in 9). “Box average” filters properly: burnt-in text and fine detail from the source become legible again. “Decimation” is the historical behaviour, faster but aliased. Averaging costs about 10× more CPU per thumbnail — watch compose_breakdown_ms.inputs on :8080.
type.multiview.cfg.scale_filter.label: Thumbnail downscaling filter
type.multiview.cfg.shm_out.label: Output SHM
type.multiview.cfg.show_no_signal.label: Show “NO SIGNAL” when the source is missing
type.multiview.cfg.slice_lines.help: Band height (lines). Must divide the frame height (36 for 1080p) — otherwise falls back to whole frame.
type.multiview.cfg.slice_lines.label: Lines per slice
type.multiview.cfg.slice_mode.help: Publishes the frame band by band on the MXL bus: downstream starts on the first band without waiting for the whole frame. Has an effect ONLY if the whole chain slices — a single monolithic stage upstream or downstream cancels the benefit (check: mxl-info on the flow, “Commit batch size” > 1). Interlaced or non-divisible height → falls back to whole frame. On a GPU node, also requires “GPU slice”.
type.multiview.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
type.multiview.cfg.tsl_mode.label: Tally/UMD source
type.multiview.cfg.tsl_port.label: Local TSL 5.0 port (Direct mode only)
type.multiview.cfg.vars_check_s.help: How often text variables (%cpu%, %time%…) are re-evaluated. Every value change re-renders the text INSIDE the frame: the more often, the more often the composition peak. 5 s suits an indicator; go down to 1 s for a clock ticking every second, at the cost of a more regular peak.
type.multiview.cfg.vars_check_s.label: Variable text refresh (s)
type.multiview.label: Multiviewer
